mia: Heads-up - need a final quality check on the webinar speaker assets before we publish landing page. focus: abstracts + 1-line speaker blurbs + rehearsal windows.

ana: On it. which abstract variant are we using? Product or technical?

mia: Product for landing page, technical for a follow-up thread and speaker promo.

tom: Draft abstract (product): "Practical Inference Economics: Learn how teams reduce inference costs while keeping latency tight. Tactical playbook + benchmarks from real deployments."

sophie: 1-line blurb for zara: "Zara — Head of Inference, Redwood. Leads infrastructure optimizations across hosted and private deployments."

ana: tom can you shorten the abstract by one sentence? keeping it punchy for social.

tom: shorter: "Practical Inference Economics: Tactical levers teams use to cut LLM cost while preserving latency and quality. Live benchmarks + demo."

mia: good. rehearsal windows? propose dry run 48h prior (45m) + tech check 1h prior. speakers join dry run 30m early.

sophie: ops note: we need one contingency slide about demo failover. host script one-liner: "If we switch demo models during scale tests, behavior is expected and leads are tagged."

ops-bot: ops-bot: contingency slide asset uploaded -> drive.redwood/webinars/assets/contingency-slide.png

ana: social copy (short): "Reduce per-token cost without slower UX. Join Redwood engineers for a practical playbook. May 15 - sign up."

mia: good. calendar-bot create the rehearsal 45m block?

calendar-bot: calendar-bot: event created "Webinar dry run - Practical Inference Economics" 2024-05-13 09:00 PT. invites sent.

tom: final checklist for publish: 1) abstract (done) 2) speaker blurbs (done) 3) landing images (designer) 4) rehearsal slots (calendar) 5) demo contingency slide (ops).

sophie: designer pinged for images. ETA 24h.

mia: perfect. i'll push landing tomorrow morning. closing thread unless any blockers. :sparkles:
